content: आसनम् [आस्-ल्युट्] .²1 Sitting down. .²2 A seat, place, stool; <ls>Bg. 11. 42</ls>; स वासवेनासनसन्निकृष्टम् <ls>Ku. 3. 2</ls>; आसनं मुच् to leave oneʼs seat, rise; <ls>R. 3. 11</ls>. .²3 A particular posture or mode of sitting; <ab>cf.</ab> पद्म˚, वीर˚, भद्र˚, वज्र˚ <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>cf.</ab> अनायासेन येन स्यादजस्रं ब्रह्मचिन्तनम् . आसनं तद् विजानीयाद् योगिनां सुखदायकम् .. .²4 Sitting down or halting, stopping, encamping. .²5 Abiding, dwelling; <ls>Ms. 2. 246</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 59</ls>. .²6 Any peculiar mode of sexual enjoyment (84 such {%āsanas%} are usually mentioned). .²7 Maintaining a post against an enemy (<ab>opp.</ab> यानम्), one of the six modes of foreign policy; which are:-- संधिर्ना विग्रहो यानमासनं द्वैधमाश्रयः <ls>Ak.</ls>; प्रतिबद्धशक्त्योः कालप्रतीक्षया तूष्णीमवस्थानमासनम्; परस्परस्य सामर्थ्यविघातादासनं स्मृतम् <ls>Agni P.</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 160</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 7.">162</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 7.">166</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 347</ls>; <ls>Pt. 3</ls>. .²8 The front part of an elephantʼs body, withers. .²9 Throwing (<ab>fr.</ab> अस् to throw). .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of two trees (असन and जीवक). .²11 Place where the elephant-rider sits, <ab>cf.</ab> मस्तकद्वितयं दन्तावासनं वंश एव च . षडेते प्रोन्नता यस्य स गजो राजवाहनः .. <ls>Mātaṅga L. 2. 1</ls>. .²12 Neutrality (as of a nation); <ls>Kau. A. 7. 1</ls>. .²13 A moving piece (draught) in the game of dice; प्राणग्लहोऽयं समर इष्वक्षो वाहनासनः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 12. 17</ls>. .{@-ना@} A seat, stool, stay. .{@-नी@} .²1 Stay, abiding, sitting. .²2 A small seat or stool. .²3 A shop, stall.
